## Plan: Replace TinyMCE emoticons icon picker with a custom dialog

**Why it's broken.** Three separate defects, verified in the built CSS:

1. **Black squares = missing token values.** [formats/components/dist/icons.css](formats/components/dist/icons.css) — the sheet the plugin injects — only contains the *mapping* `.-icon-heart{--pantoken-glyph:var(--instui-icon-heart)}`. It never defines `--instui-icon-heart`. The per-icon file [formats/components/dist/icons/heart.css](formats/components/dist/icons/heart.css) *is* self-contained. So the mask resolves to nothing and `background: currentColor` paints a solid 1em square — for all ~1,400 Instructure UI icons. The three plugin bundles inline their `:root` tokens, which is why brand/Lucide glyphs do render.
2. **Painter rule never injected.** `[class*="-icon-"]::before` lives in `components.css`, not in any of the four injected sheets. It only works today by accident.
3. **Layout.** Emoticons sizes `.tox-collection__item` for one emoji character; wide wordmark SVGs blow out the grid.

Scale: ~6,827 icons (components 1,401 · simple-icons 4,175 · lucide-lab 1,239 · custom 12), all already bundled into the TinyMCE JS.

**Steps**

**Phase 1 — Data layer** (`renderers/tinymce/src/icons.ts`)
1. Drop `EmoticonEntry`, `buildEmoticonsDatabase`, `PANTOKEN_ICONS_DATABASE_ID`, `matchInsertedIcon`. Keep `TaggedIcon`, `loadAllIcons`, `getIconCdnFile`, `buildIconMarkup`.
2. Add pure `filterIcons(icons, query, source)` and `SOURCE_LABELS`.
3. Add `getIconDataUri(icon)` — pulls the inline SVG from `rebrandTokens` / custom-icons embedded data (reusing `decodeIconToken` from [renderers/tinymce/src/icon-pack.ts](renderers/tinymce/src/icon-pack.ts)); `undefined` for simple-icons and lucide-lab.

**Phase 2 — Preview CSS** (new `lib/icon-preview-css.ts`) — *depends on 3*
4. One idempotent `injectPickerStyles(doc)` that adds: the painter rule **scoped to the picker root** so it can't leak into the host page; a generated `<style>` of `:root{--instui-icon-*}` built from in-bundle data (zero network); and `<link>`s for only the two self-contained bundles that aren't in the JS. Opening the dialog then costs 2 requests, none per icon.

**Phase 3 — Dialog DOM** (new `lib/icon-picker-dom.ts`)
5. `renderPickerMarkup()` — search input, source tab row, scrollable grid, live count, load-more sentinel, all under a `pantoken-ip__*` namespace with its own CSS.
6. `mountPicker(root, icons, { onPick })` — debounced search, tab filtering, 200-tile chunks appended via IntersectionObserver, roving-tabindex keyboard nav. Build tiles with `document.createElement`, not string interpolation, so icon names can't inject markup. Returns `{ destroy() }`.

**Phase 4 — Plugin rewrite** (`renderers/tinymce/src/plugins/icons.ts`)
7. `windowManager.open` with a single `htmlpanel`, `presets: "presentation"`; mount on open, `destroy()` on close. Mirrors the dialog shape already used in [renderers/tinymce/src/plugins/components.ts](renderers/tinymce/src/plugins/components.ts).
8. On pick: `insertHtml` via `lib/insertion-target.ts` + `trackAndInjectAsset`. The `ExecCommand`/`data-pantoken-icon` round trip disappears — we know the icon directly.
9. Keep the `pantokenIcons` button and menu item.
10. `addAutocompleter` with a configurable `trigger`, default `"::"`. TinyMCE merges results across autocompleters sharing a trigger, so `:` must stay free for the stock emoji plugin. Items use `cardmenuitem` + `CardImage` with the SVG data URI as `src` where available.

**Phase 5 — Integration**
11. New strings in `strings.ts` + `l10n/tinymce.strings.pot`.
12. Update `plugins/pantoken.ts` and `src/index.ts`.
13. Grep out `emoticons` / `emoticons_database_id` from demos, README, `ai/pantoken-ai`, scaffold templates.
14. Changeset; amend `ASSURANCE.md` for the new runtime-`<style>` and htmlpanel surfaces.

**Verification**
1. Package unit tests (happy-dom): `filterIcons`, `getIconDataUri`, tile-construction escaping, chunking.
2. `vp check --fix`, `vp run ready`, `pnpm run check:publish`; `vp test --coverage` last (≥85%).
3. **Manual browser pass (required — the bug is visual):** no black squares in the Instructure UI tab; uniform square tiles; smooth scroll through 6.8k icons; search spans sources; picked icon renders in the body *and* in CodeMirror source view.
4. Network panel: exactly 2 stylesheet requests on dialog open.
5. Type `::heart`; then enable the stock `emoticons` plugin and confirm `:` still yields emoji only.

**Decisions**
- No CDN calls for previews — components/custom glyphs come from data already in the JS bundle; only simple-icons and lucide-lab need their (self-contained) bundle sheets.
- Logos stay out of this picker.
- Emoticons is fully replaced, but a consumer can still add the stock emoji plugin without a trigger collision.

**Further considerations**
1. `formats/components/dist/icons.css` is broken for *every* CDN consumer, not just TinyMCE. Fix it to be self-contained? Recommend: file separately rather than widen this change.
2. Autocompleter rows for simple-icons/lucide-lab: text-only (recommended) vs. on-demand fetch of `dist/icons/<name>.css` for the ≤10 matches to extract a data URI.
3. Trigger default: `::` (recommended) vs `;` vs configurable-only with no default registration.

**2. Why the autocompleter icon question exists** — and a better third option I found while re-checking.

TinyMCE autocompleter rows can show an icon, but only if we can hand it real image data (`CardImage.src`) or a registered SVG. For Instructure UI and custom icons the SVG data URI is already sitting in the JS bundle (`rebrandTokens`, custom-icons `embedded.ts`), so it's free. For Simple Icons (4,175) and Lucide Lab (1,239) only the *names* are bundled — the SVGs live in CSS. Hence the original either/or: text-only rows, or fetch up to 10 per-icon CSS files on every keystroke and regex the data URI out.

But the plugin already injects those two bundle sheets into the top-level document at init. Once they're loaded, `getComputedStyle(document.documentElement).getPropertyValue("--instui-icon-<name>")` returns the literal `url('data:image/svg+xml;utf8,…')` token, which the existing `decodeIconToken` regex in [renderers/tinymce/src/icon-pack.ts](renderers/tinymce/src/icon-pack.ts) already knows how to unwrap. So: **read the data URI back out of the loaded stylesheet**, no per-keystroke network, and every source gets a real icon in the autocompleter. Falls back to text-only if the property is empty (sheet not yet loaded). I've adopted this in the plan.

**1. Fixing `icons.css`** adds a phase. The tradeoff to know about: inlining the `:root` tokens grows [formats/components/dist/icons.css](formats/components/dist/icons.css) from a mapping-only file to roughly 1 MB, and consumers who already load the tokens sheet will define those custom properties twice (identical values, last-wins — harmless, just bytes). That matches how `simple-icons.css`, `lucide-lab.css`, `custom-icons.css`, and every `dist/icons/<name>.css` already behave.

Added as **Phase 2b**. Summary of the addition:

**Phase 2b — Paint icons inside the editor content area**

The inserted `<span class="instui-icon -icon-X">` only paints in the iframe today if the consumer happened to add `components.css` to `content_css`. Otherwise it's an invisible zero-width span — hard to see, select, or delete.

- New shared partial `renderers/tinymce/oxide/src/less/skins/content/_pantoken-icons.less` carrying the `.instui-icon` sizing rule plus the `[class*="-icon-"]::before` painter (mask + `background: currentColor`).

- Recoloring comes free — `background: currentColor` means TinyMCE's forecolor button already works on the span.
- Give the empty span a minimum hit area so it's a real click/selection target in contenteditable instead of a zero-width caret position.
- The `--instui-icon-X` value still arrives per-icon via `trackAndInjectAsset`; the content skin ships only the painter, never 6.8k tokens.
- Drift test keeps the partial in sync with the canonical [formats/components/src/utilities/icon/icon.css](formats/components/src/utilities/icon/icon.css).
- Duplication is harmless if a consumer also loads `components.css` into `content_css` — identical declarations, last-wins.

**New verification step 4b:** per content skin, insert an icon and confirm it's visible with *no* `components.css` in `content_css`, is selectable, deletes with one Backspace, recolors via forecolor, and scales with the surrounding font size.

One thing I did *not* add, since it changes output HTML: marking inserted icons `contenteditable="false"` (or `mceNonEditable`) would make each icon a single atomic unit — one click selects it, one Backspace removes it cleanly. The minimum-hit-area approach gets most of the benefit without altering the HTML consumers get. Say the word if you'd rather have the atomic behavior.

{"content": "---
"@pantoken/tinymce": minor
"@pantoken/scaffold": patch
---

Replace the TinyMCE icons picker's emoticons-database backing with a purpose-built dialog. The
previous approach relied on `@pantoken/components`' `icons.css`, which maps `-icon-<name>` classes to
`--instui-icon-*` tokens it never defines, so every Instructure UI glyph painted as a solid square;
TinyMCE's emoticon grid also sized its cells for single characters, which broke the layout for wide
brand glyphs. The picker now owns its markup, tabs by source, filters as you type, and renders in
chunks as you scroll.

Glyph previews for the sources this package already bundles are declared from in-memory token data,
so opening the dialog costs two stylesheet requests rather than one per icon. A new `::name`
autocompleter inserts an icon without leaving the keyboard; the trigger is configurable and defaults
to `::` so the stock `emoticons` plugin can still claim `:`. Consumers no longer need to register the
`emoticons` plugin or set `emoticons_database_id`, and `PANTOKEN_ICONS_DATABASE_ID`,
`buildEmoticonsDatabase`, and `matchInsertedIcon` are gone.

The Oxide content skins now carry the icon painter, so an inserted icon is visible, selectable,
deletable, and recolorable in the editing surface without the host adding `components.css` to
`content_css`.

content.text:
Implementation is complete and the gate passes, but I could not finish the browser verification — details below.

## What changed

**Root cause fixed at the source.** [formats/components/dist/icons.css](formats/components/dist/icons.css) shipped only the `.-icon-<name>` → `var(--instui-icon-<name>)` mapping and never declared those tokens, so the mask resolved to nothing and `background: currentColor` painted a solid square for every Instructure UI glyph. `iconGlyphsCss` now takes a `values` option and [formats/components/scripts/generate.ts](formats/components/scripts/generate.ts) feeds it, making the sheet self-contained like its siblings.

**New picker.** [renderers/tinymce/src/plugins/icons.ts](renderers/tinymce/src/plugins/icons.ts) opens a `windowManager` dialog with a single `htmlpanel` shell that [src/lib/icon-picker-dom.ts](renderers/tinymce/src/lib/icon-picker-dom.ts) fills in: search, source tabs, a grid rendered 150 tiles at a time behind an IntersectionObserver, and roving-tabindex arrow navigation. Tiles are built with `createElement`, so an icon name can never become markup. [src/lib/icon-picker-styles.ts](renderers/tinymce/src/lib/icon-picker-styles.ts) installs a painter scoped to the picker root, a `:root` block generated from in-bundle token data, and links for only the two sources whose SVGs aren't in the JS bundle — two requests per dialog open, none per icon.

**Autocompleter.** `::name` inserts an icon from the keyboard. Rows resolve a real glyph for all four sources: bundled data first, else reading `--instui-icon-<name>` back off the loaded stylesheet. The trigger is configurable so the stock emoji plugin keeps `:`.

**Editor content.** [oxide/src/less/skins/content/pantoken-icons.less](renderers/tinymce/oxide/src/less/skins/content/pantoken-icons.less) is imported by all three compiled content skins, so an inserted icon paints, has a real click target, and recolors via forecolor without `components.css` in `content_css`.

**Removed.** `PANTOKEN_ICONS_DATABASE_ID`, `buildEmoticonsDatabase`, `matchInsertedIcon`, the `ExecCommand`/`data-pantoken-icon` round trip, and the `emoticons` plugin requirement in the scaffold template.

## Verification

- 551 tests pass across the touched packages; 34 are new (picker DOM, style injection, filtering, glyph resolution, autocompleter).
- `vp check` clean: formatted, no lint warnings, no type errors.
- Oxide skins recompile and the painter is present in all three `content.css` outputs.

## Not done

1. **Browser verification is outstanding.** The dev server at `:5174` had already died, and `.dev/canvas-theme-editor` can't be served — `vp dev` there fails with `Expected @voidzero-dev/vite-plus-core@0.3.3, but found vite@8.2.2`, a stale Vite alias in that scratch app's `node_modules` needing `vp migrate` + `vp install`. I didn't run those since it mutates your scratch environment. The one thing I'd most want eyes on: the plugin looks up the dialog shell by id immediately after `windowManager.open` returns, which is the documented TinyMCE pattern but I couldn't confirm it live. I did mirror the template edits into the gitignored `.dev` copy so it'll work once the toolchain is fixed.
2. **43 locales are in drift** for the six new UI strings. I extracted the POT but didn't run `vp run translate` — the namespace currently has ~2,035 other drift units from a concurrent layouts i18n refactor in this workspace, and a translate run would sweep those into this change.
